sections.tools:
<tools>
- read: Read file contents
- write: Create or overwrite files
- edit: Make precise file edits with exact text replacement, including multiple disjoint edits in one call

In addition to the tools above, you may have access to other custom tools depending on the project.
</tools>
sections.rules:
<rules>
- Use read to examine files instead of cat or sed.
- Use write only for new files or complete rewrites.
- Use edit for precise changes (edits[].oldText must match exactly)
- When changing multiple separate locations in one file, use one edit call with multiple entries in edits[] instead of multiple edit calls
- Each edits[].oldText is matched against the original file, not after earlier edits are applied. Do not emit overlapping or nested edits. Merge nearby changes into one edit.
- Keep edits[].oldText as small as possible while still being unique in the file. Do not pad with large unchanged regions.
- Be concise in your responses
- Show file paths clearly when working with files
</rules>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 900" width="1200" height="900" role="img" aria-labelledby="title description">
  <title id="title">The Amazing Anteater's Unicycle Juggling Act</title>
  <desc id="description">A storybook-style anteater in a red fez rides a golden unicycle, pedaling and swaying while three colorful bottles flip between its hands beneath a circus arch.</desc>

  <defs>

      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#e5ad76"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#bb794e"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="tailFur" x1="0.1" y1="0" x2="0.9" y2="1">

      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#714937"/>

    <filter id="blur" x="-30%" y="-100%" width="160%" height="300%">

    <path id="arch" d="M105 824V357C105 163 319 42 600 42C881 42 1095 163 1095 357V824Z"/>
    <clipPath id="archClip">

    </clipPath>
    <clipPath id="bodyClip">
      <path d="M552 320C588 300 640 307 672 343C705 380 707 440 681 484C661 518 627 535 591 523C550 510 526 474 519 425C512 378 522 340 552 320Z"/>

    <path id="spark" d="M0-12L3-3L12 0L3 3L0 12L-3 3L-12 0L-3-3Z"/>

    <!-- A bottle centered on the origin; color is supplied by each use. -->

      <path d="M-9-44V-29C-9-24-13-21-18-16C-22-12-23-6-23 2V38C-23 48-17 52-9 52H9C17 52 23 48 23 38V2C23-6 22-12 18-16C13-21 9-24 9-29V-44Z" fill="currentColor" stroke-width="4"/>
      <path d="M8-41V-27C8-20 18-17 18-5V38C18 44 15 47 10 48H2C9 43 10 35 10 25V-2C10-15 3-20 3-28V-41Z" fill="#173f3f" opacity="0.16" stroke="none"/>
      <rect x="-12" y="-54" width="24" height="11" rx="3" fill="#e5aa45" stroke-width="3"/>
      <path d="M-8-50H8M-8-47H8" fill="none" stroke="#fff0c9" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.7"/>
      <rect x="-21" y="5" width="42" height="26" rx="5" fill="#fff0cf" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <path d="M0 10L2.5 15.2L8 16L4 20L5.2 25.5L0 22.8L-5.2 25.5L-4 20L-8 16L-2.5 15.2Z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"/>

    </g>

  <!-- Circus-poster backdrop -->

  <g fill="#e7b152">

  <use href="#arch" fill="url(#spotlight)"/>
  <g clip-path="url(#archClip)">

  <!-- Quiet poster ornaments and airborne sparkles -->

    <circle cx="576" cy="76" r="2.5"/>

  <g fill="#d9a343">
    <g transform="translate(353 188)"><g><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="scale" values="0.55;1;0.55" dur="2.7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/><use href="#spark"/><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.25;0.85;0.25" dur="2.7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></g></g>
    <g transform="translate(845 210)"><g><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="scale" values="0.6;1.1;0.6" dur="3.1s" begin="-1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/><use href="#spark"/><animate attributeName="opacity" values="0.25;0.9;0.25" dur="3.1s" begin="-1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></g></g>
    <g transform="translate(776 105)"><g><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="scale" values="0.45;0.8;0.45" dur="2.4s" begin="-0.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/><use href="#spark"/></g></g>
    <circle cx="404" cy="121" r="4" opacity="0.55"/>

  <!-- Ground shadow gently breathes with the balancing act. -->
  <ellipse cx="600" cy="824" rx="154" ry="17" fill="#173f3f" opacity="0.22" filter="url(#blur)">
    <animate attributeName="rx" values="148;160;148" dur="4.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

  <ellipse cx="600" cy="820" rx="34" ry="5" fill="#173f3f" opacity="0.32"/>

    </g>

    <!-- Three bottles follow a six-second, alternating-hand cascade. The small
         loops at either end are the hand carries between throws. -->

        <animateMotion dur="6s" begin="0s" repeatCount="indefinite" path="M438 390C438 220 490 110 600 110C710 110 762 220 762 370C782 390 776 415 756 410C740 406 744 382 762 370C762 220 710 110 600 110C490 110 438 220 438 390C418 410 424 435 444 430C460 426 456 402 438 390"/>
        <g>

          <g transform="scale(0.82)"><use href="#bottle" color="#4d9b82"/></g>
        </g>
      </g>
      <g>
        <animateMotion dur="6s" begin="-2s" repeatCount="indefinite" path="M438 390C438 220 490 110 600 110C710 110 762 220 762 370C782 390 776 415 756 410C740 406 744 382 762 370C762 220 710 110 600 110C490 110 438 220 438 390C418 410 424 435 444 430C460 426 456 402 438 390"/>
        <g>

        </g>

      <g>
        <animateMotion dur="6s" begin="-4s" repeatCount="indefinite" path="M438 390C438 220 490 110 600 110C710 110 762 220 762 370C782 390 776 415 756 410C740 406 744 382 762 370C762 220 710 110 600 110C490 110 438 220 438 390C418 410 424 435 444 430C460 426 456 402 438 390"/>
        <g>
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0;330;360;690;720" keyTimes="0;0.43;0.5;0.93;1" dur="6s" begin="-4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
          <g transform="scale(0.82)"><use href="#bottle" color="#579ca6"/></g>
        </g>
      </g>
    </g>

      <circle cx="600" cy="700" r="112" fill="#fff1cf" fill-opacity="0.13" stroke="#173f3f" stroke-width="17"/>
      <circle cx="600" cy="700" r="101" fill="none" stroke="#d8a147" stroke-width="4"/>
      <g stroke="#9b794e" stroke-width="2.4" opacity="0.72">

    <!-- Shoes follow the same circular pedal path, remaining level. -->
